job.text: pail of milk, she said to the Oldest Ox, who happened to be standing near,-- "Old Ox, pray tell me, what is a moon-calf?" The Oldest Ox did not know anything about moon-calves, but he had no idea of betraying his ignorance to anybody, much less to a very young cow; so he answered promptly, "It's a calf that lives in the moon, of course." "Is it--are they--like other calves?" inquired the cow, timidly, "or a different sort of animal?" "When a creature is called a calf," replied the Ox
